claims.claim: Uses a random80/20 split rather than this project's official holdout.
Cross-validated base predictions train SGD meta; GNB/DT/LR are bases.
MinMax scaling and Chi-square feature selection are described.
Complete fold-local fitting/nesting is not established by the selected reporting; actual leakage is not proved.
Reports UNSW binary accuracy93.88; it is not our official-test metric or a reproduced result.
UNSW multiclass accuracy80.96 is a different task from its binary result and from current binary-only research.
Imbalance augmentation and cost-sensitive improvements are future directions, not evidence that current matched resampling was tested.

claims.anchor: aggregated the training and testing datasets
claims.claim: Merges original partitions then randomly assigns80/20; directly incompatible with current frozen official split.
MI and Boruta selected sets are intersected;27 features for UNSW and37 for CIC.
RF/XGB/Catboost use five-fold base CV with MLP meta; full nested selector isolation is a separate unverified question.
Reports UNSW binary accuracy95.34,F1 93.62,FPR4.2%; not a protocol-matched ranking against current results.
One computation-time set is reported; timing stage and scope cannot be equated to current historical end-to-end TRAIN fit time.
Dataset prose prints83,332 TEST while current verified file has82,332. Cannot infer which actual file the external implementation used.
Separate evaluations on two datasets do not by themselves establish fixed-model cross-network transfer or unknown-attack performance.
